prompt: Give a short, rousing speech to annex the Wendy's parking lot on Route 9.
response:
Friends! Neighbors! Warriors of the suburban commute! Look across the treacherous four lanes of Route 9! What do you see? 

You see a beacon of the square patty. You see a Frosty machine that is, by some miracle, actually working today. But more importantly, you see *unclaimed asphalt*. 

For too long, the sprawling expanse of the Wendy’s parking lot has been a lawless no-man's-land. We have suffered its potholes! We have endured the chaotic merging of the drive-thru line! We have watched seagulls claim sovereign territory over dropped fries! No more!

Today, we do not just cross the street—we cross into history! We will plant our flag beside the dumpster enclosure! We will secure the strategic high ground of the curbside pickup zones! From the faded yellow parking lines of the eastern perimeter to the storm drain in the west, it shall be our territory! 

Manifest Destiny does not end at the highway median—it ends at the drive-thru speaker! So start your minivans! Sound your horns! Tonight, we dine on spicy nuggets, and tomorrow, the Wendy’s parking lot on Route 9 belongs to US! 

*Forward!*
